principles.name: God exists
principles.text: God exists and is the cause of all that exists

principles.name: God is one
principles.text: God is one, with an absolute unity unlike any other

principles.name: God is incorporeal
principles.text: God has no body or physical form and is unaffected by physical events

principles.name: God is eternal
principles.text: God is eternal and preceded everything

principles.name: Worship God alone
principles.text: Only God may be worshipped and prayed to, with no intermediary

principles.name: Prophecy
principles.text: God communicates with human beings through true prophecy

principles.name: Moses' prophecy
principles.text: The prophecy of Moses was true and superior to that of all other prophets

principles.name: Torah from Heaven
principles.text: The entire Torah we have was given by God to Moses, word for word (Torah min hashamayim), including the Oral Law's core

principles.name: Torah is unchanging
principles.text: The Torah will never be replaced, revised, or abrogated

principles.name: God knows our deeds
principles.text: God knows human deeds and thoughts

principles.name: Reward and punishment
principles.text: God rewards those who keep the commandments and punishes those who transgress
